# finality status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:finalityStatus`](gmeow-finalityStatus.md)

- **Category:** property

The finality status of a ledger transaction or block. Domain-free.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; `?` -> [`gmeow:LedgerFinalityStatus`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerFinalityStatus.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:finalityStatus`](gmeow-finalityStatus.md) from `?` to [`gmeow:LedgerFinalityStatus`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerFinalityStatus.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:LedgerFinalityStatus`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerFinalityStatus.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to classify the settlement state of a ledger transaction or block — pending, confirmed, finalized, orphaned, reorged — naming a [`gmeow:LedgerFinalityStatus`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerFinalityStatus.md) individual.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the raw confirmation count (that is [`gmeow:confirmationDepth`](gmeow-confirmationDepth.md)) and for the verification verdict of an attestation ([`gmeow:hasVerificationStatus`](gmeow-hasVerificationStatus.md)); finality is the chain-settlement state, not a block count or an attestation check.

### How to use

- Reference a [`gmeow:LedgerFinalityStatus`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerFinalityStatus.md) individual, observed at a point in time; the chain-finality determination itself runs in the solver layer ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)), and the status may change as the chain advances.

### Examples

- ex:tx1 [`gmeow:finalityStatus`](gmeow-finalityStatus.md) [`gmeow:finalityStatusFinalized`](../individuals/gmeow-finalityStatusFinalized.md).
